objective: Test whether persistent observation-only frontier and bounded goal context produces useful progress from states not used to tune cycle-aware-v1.

source.selectionReason: Two fixed later committed points outside the v1 saved fixtures and v1 step-3029 branch; no state-dependent replacement is allowed.

providerCallAccounting: 2 branch points times (32 baseline actions + 32 v2 actions + at most 32 v2 goal judgments)
frontierMemoryConstruction: During provider-free exact replay, feed every captured raw observation through run.make_state and candidate.observe with its full-array digest. Do not import unseen map, seed internals, save data, or future observations.

goalLifecycle.chooser: Jev Choice over the complete frozen goal criteria

actionLifecycle.chooser: Jev Choice for every actual action
actionLifecycle.criteria: the complete ordered 121-action mapping with contextual labels

retention: full raw goal request and response bodies and complete goal probability distribution
full raw action request and response bodies and all 121 action probabilities
raw before and after NLE observation arrays with hashes
memory snapshot and digest, active goal contract, criteria, instructions, action and terminal outcome
measures: cells newly visited relative to each exact prefix
observed frontier targets reached and route distance changes
exact raw no-ops, unchanged-position actions, and blank or wall attempts
prompt, combat, low-HP, and hunger goal/action handling
NetHack turns, score, depth, experience level, HP, hunger, termination, truncation, and verified ascension
stopRules: retain and stop an arm on termination or truncation; never reset or replace it
stop on any replay mismatch or preservation failure
do not replace a branch point, tune questions, or extend an arm after results
acceptance: Development evidence only. Consider live migration only after both fixed pairs preserve safety/menu behavior and show more useful objective progress than baseline without a replacement cycle. Confidence is never accuracy.
